newsitem.title: USA: Horton says "comfortable" with Q3 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Horton says "comfortable" with Q3 estimates.

text.p: D.R. Horton Inc said on Wednesday it will delay until August 5 releasing its results for the third quarter ending June 30, but said it was "comfortable" with Wall Street analysts' consensus estimate for the period.
Horton said in a news release that it was delaying its results from the normal schedule due to its biennial planning session.
The First Call estimate for the company's 1997 third quarter earnings per share was $0.26.
Horton also said it signed $269.1 million in new sales contracts in its third quarter ending June 30, up from $166.9 million for the same period the year before.
Contracts signed during the 1997 period were for 1,617 homes, compared to 996 for the third quarter of 1996, the company said.
Excluding sales associated with the February acquisition of Torrey Homes, Horton had 1,213 new sales contracts in the third quarter, for $210.2 million.
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, Horton had sales contracts for 3,469 homes, totaling $611.2 million, compared to 2,723 homes and $457.2 million for the year-ago period.
